questions.q: According to Schopenhauer, what two pillars form personality?
questions.why: He says personality rests on body and mind.

questions.q: What does Schopenhauer say about a healthy body?
a: It is necessary for a happy soul
questions.why: He calls health a prerequisite for happiness.

questions.q: Which philosopher influenced Schopenhauer's three categories of material needs?
questions.why: The three needs model comes from Epicurus.
Position is the cumulated result of others' opinions.

questions.q: What is the difference between objective and subjective honor for Schopenhauer?
a: Objective is others' view, subjective is self‑view
Objective is legal status, subjective is fame
Objective is wealth, subjective is talent
Objective is health, subjective is mood
questions.why: He splits honor into others' opinion vs self‑opinion.
